title: Neman gidan zama
description: Ten short stories about finding and keeping a home in Hausaland and beyond: a student's room near her college in Kano, a youth corps member taken in by a village elder, a thief in Zaria, a storm on the bank of the Niger, a residents' meeting in Kaduna, a retired couple's garden in Gombe, a letter about rent and snow in London, a Christian family looking for a house near a church, a factory worker who learns to drive to his own house and a new neighbour's soup in Bauchi.

lessons.title: Ɗaki kusa da kwaleji
lessons.summary: Mansura comes from her village to study at a college in Kano; she looks at three rooms, chooses the one with a window and a bathroom, and her father sends her a bicycle for the long way.
lessons.text:
Mansura budurwa ce mai shekara 19 daga wani ƙauye kusa da Kano. A wannan shekara za ta fara karatu a wani kwaleji a cikin birnin Kano. Kwalejin yana da nisa daga ƙauyensu, saboda haka dole ta nemi ɗaki a gari.

Kafin ta tafi, mahaifinta ya ba ta kuɗi dubu hamsin. Ya ce mata, "Idan kika sami ɗaki, kada ki biya fiye da dubu hamsin a shekara. "

A Kano, Mansura ta je ta ga ɗakuna uku. Ɗaki na farko yana kusa da kwalejin, amma ba shi da taga, kuma babu iska a cikinsa. Ɗaki na biyu yana da babbar taga, amma babu ɗakin wanka a gidan. Wanda yake so ya yi wanka sai ya je wani gida. Ɗaki na uku yana da taga biyu da ƙaramin ɗakin wanka, amma yana da nisa da kwalejin.

Mansura ba ta san wanne za ta zaɓa ba. Ta kira mahaifinta ta waya, ta faɗa masa cewa ɗaki na uku ya fi kyau, amma tafiya daga can zuwa kwalejin tana ɗaukar awa ɗaya a ƙafa.

Mahaifinta ya ce, "Ɗakin da yake da taga da ɗakin wanka shi ne ya fi dacewa. Idan hanyar ta yi nisa, zan aiko da keke. Da keke, tafiyar ba za ta yi tsawo ba."

Mai gidan, wata mata mai suna Kubra, ta ce kuɗin ɗakin dubu arba'in ne a shekara, kuma akwai dubu goma na ruwa da wutar lantarki. "Jimlar kuɗin dubu hamsin ne," ta ce. Mansura ta yi lissafi, ta ga cewa jimlar ta yi daidai da kuɗin da mahaifinta ya ba ta.

"To, wannan ne ɗakin da na zaɓa," Mansura ta ce wa Kubra.

Bayan mako ɗaya, keke ya zo daga ƙauye. Yanzu kowace safiya Mansura tana zuwa kwaleji a kan kekenta. Tafiyar keke tana ɗaukar minti goma sha biyar kawai.

A ɗakinta, Mansura ta sa ƙaramin teburi kusa da taga. Ta ajiye kwamfutarta a kan teburin. Da dare tana karatu da kwamfutarta a kan teburi har ƙarfe goma. Sannan ta yi wanka, ta kwanta barci. Saboda ta gaji, barci yana ɗaukar ta da sauri.

Wata rana mahaifinta ya kira ta. "Yaya ɗakin da kika zaɓa?" ya ce.

"Baba, ɗakina yana da kyau," ta ce. "Ina da taga, da ɗakin wanka, da teburi. Ina karatu da kyau, kuma ina barci lafiya."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Mansura take neman ɗaki a Kano?
Saboda kwalejin da za ta yi karatu yana da nisa daga ƙauyensu.
Kuɗi nawa mahaifinta ya ba ta?
Ya ba ta kuɗi dubu hamsin.
Me ɗaki na farko ba shi da shi?
Ɗaki na farko ba shi da taga.
Nawa ne jimlar kuɗin ɗakin da ta zaɓa?
Jimlar kuɗin dubu hamsin ne.
Yaya Mansura take zuwa kwaleji yanzu?
Tana zuwa kwaleji a kan keke.

lessons.title: Ɗan hidimar ƙasa
lessons.summary: Huzaifa is sent to a village in the Katsina emirate for his year of national service; the old man Dayyabu gives him a room, introduces him to the villagers, and at the end of the year the emirate thanks him.
lessons.text:
Huzaifa matashi ne da ya gama jami'a a Abuja. Yanzu yana yin hidimar ƙasa ta shekara ɗaya. An tura shi wani ƙauye a masarautar Katsina, inda zai koyar a makarantar firamare.

Da Huzaifa ya iso ƙauyen da yamma, bai san kowa ba, kuma ba shi da wurin zama. Shugaban makarantar ya kai shi wurin wani dattijo mai suna Malam Dayyabu. Malam Dayyabu dattijo ne mai shekara 70. Ya taso a ƙauyen nan, ya yi aure a nan, kuma 'ya'yansa duka sun taso a nan. Kowa a ƙauyen yana girmama shi.

"Barka da zuwa," dattijon ya ce. "Ashe kai ne ɗan hidimar ƙasa da muke jira? Ka iso lafiya?"

"Na iso lafiya, Baba. Na gode," Huzaifa ya ce.

Malam Dayyabu ya ce masa, "Ina da ɗaki a ƙofar gidana da babu kowa a ciki. Za ka iya zama a can har ka gama hidimarka."

Washegari, dattijon ya fita tare da Huzaifa. Ya sada shi da mai garin, da limamin masallaci, da wasu mazauna ƙauyen. Kowa ya ce masa, "Barka da zuwa." Huzaifa ya ga cewa mazauna ƙauyen suna girmama baƙi sosai.

Mai garin ya ce, "Ƙauyenmu yana cikin masarautar Katsina. Masarautar tana da ƙauyuka da yawa, amma mutanen nan sun fi kowa kirki."

Huzaifa ya koyi al'adar girmamawa ta ƙauyen. Idan ya ga dattijo a hanya, sai ya tsaya ya gaishe shi da girmamawa. Da yamma yana zama da Malam Dayyabu a ƙofar gida suna hira. Dattijon ya sada shi da mutane da yawa, har ya zama kamar ɗan ƙauyen.

Huzaifa ya koyar da yara a makaranta har shekara ta ƙare. Yaran sun koyi karatu da lissafi sosai.

Da hidimarsa ta ƙare, mazauna ƙauyen suka yi masa ƙaramin biki. Masarautar Katsina ta aiko da wakili. Wakilin masarautar ya ce, "Mun gode maka saboda hidimar da ka yi wa yaranmu."

Huzaifa ya ce wa Malam Dayyabu, "Baba, ka girmama ni kamar ɗanka. Ba zan manta da ku ba."

Dattijon ya ce, "Kai ma ka nuna mana girmamawa, ɗana. Allah ya kai ka gida lafiya."

Tambayoyi:
Ina aka tura Huzaifa?
An tura shi wani ƙauye a masarautar Katsina.
Wane ne Malam Dayyabu?
Dattijo ne mai shekara 70 da ya taso a ƙauyen.
Me Malam Dayyabu ya ba Huzaifa?
Ya ba shi ɗaki a ƙofar gidansa.
Da wa dattijon ya sada Huzaifa?
Ya sada shi da mai garin, da limamin masallaci, da wasu mazauna ƙauyen.
Me wakilin masarautar ya ce?
Ya ce, "Mun gode maka saboda hidimar da ka yi wa yaranmu."

lessons.title: Ɓarawo da dare
lessons.summary: In Zaria, the dog's barking wakes Nusaiba in the dark; a thief has broken the window and snatched her phone, the police find a shoe as proof, Nusaiba identifies her phone by its photos, and the thief goes to prison.
lessons.text:
Abdulkadir da matarsa Nusaiba suna zaune a wani gida a Zaria. Suna da wani babban kare a gidansu.

Wata dare wutar lantarki ta ɗauke, kuma gidan duka yana cikin duhu. Da ƙarfe biyu na dare, karen ya fara haushi. Nusaiba ta farka saboda haushin karen. Sai ta ji wata ƙara: wani ya fasa taga a babban ɗaki.

"Abdulkadir, tashi! Wani ya fasa taga!" ta ce.

Abdulkadir ya tashi ya ɗauki fitila. A cikin duhu, ya ga wani ɓarawo yana fita ta tagar da ya fasa. Ɓarawon ya kwace wayar Nusaiba daga kan teburi ya gudu. Karen ya bi shi yana haushi, amma ɓarawon ya hau bango ya ɓace a cikin duhu.

Da safe 'yan sanda biyu suka zo. Suka bincika gidan duka. Suka bincika babban ɗakin da taga da bayan gida. A ƙarƙashin taga, suka sami takalmi ɗaya. "Wannan takalmin ɓarawon ne," wani ɗan sanda ya ce. "Hujja ce mai kyau."

Bayan kwana uku, 'yan sanda suka kama wani matashi a kasuwa. Yana da waya kamar ta Nusaiba, kuma ƙafarsa ɗaya babu takalmi. Matashin ya ce ba shi ne ɓarawon ba. Ya ce wayarsa ce. Ya ce ya saye ta a kasuwa.

'Yan sanda suka kira Nusaiba. "Dole mu tantance cewa wayarki ce," suka ce. Nusaiba ta duba wayar. "Ita ce," ta ce. "A ciki akwai hotunana da na mijina." 'Yan sanda suka buɗe wayar suka ga hotunan. Sannan suka tantance takalmin: ya yi daidai da ɗayan takalmin da yake ƙafar matashin.

Yanzu 'yan sanda suna da hujja biyu: wayar da takalmin. Da aka kai shi kotu, alƙali ya duba hujja biyun, ya ce matashin ɓarawo ne. Aka ɗaure shi a gidan yari na wata shida.

Bayan haka, Abdulkadir ya sa ƙarfe a kan dukan tagogin gidan. Da dare kuma yana ɗaure karen a ƙofar gida. Nusaiba ta ce, "Yanzu idan wani ɓarawo ya zo, karen zai yi haushi, kuma ba zai iya fasa taga ba."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Nusaiba ta farka?
Ta farka saboda haushin karen.
Me ɓarawon ya kwace?
Ya kwace wayar Nusaiba daga kan teburi.
Wace hujja 'yan sanda suka samu a ƙarƙashin taga?
Sun sami takalmin ɓarawon.
Yaya Nusaiba ta tantance wayarta?
Ta ce akwai hotunanta da na mijinta a ciki.
Me aka yi wa ɓarawon?
Aka ɗaure shi a gidan yari na wata shida.

lessons.title: Guguwa a gaɓar kogi
lessons.summary: A storm tears the roof off Rabilu and Hamida's house on the bank of the Niger near Yauri; relief workers bring rice and plastic sheets, and Hamida says the real solution is to build away from the bank.
lessons.text:
Rabilu yana kama kifi a Kogin Nijar. Shi da matarsa Hamida da yaransu uku suna zaune a wani ƙaramin gida a gaɓar kogi, kusa da garin Yauri. Daga ƙofar gidansu, suna iya ganin ruwan kogin.

Wata rana da yamma, iska mai ƙarfi ta taso — wata babbar guguwa ce. Guguwar ta yi awanni uku. Ta ɗauke rufin gidan Rabilu, ruwan sama kuma ya shiga ko'ina a cikin gidan. Hamida da yaran suka gudu zuwa masallaci, inda wasu mutane suka zauna har guguwar ta wuce.

Da safe, Rabilu ya koma gida. Akwai lalacewa ko'ina. Rufin ya tafi, bango ɗaya ya faɗi, kuma ruwa ya ɓata kayansu. Gidajen da suke gaɓar kogi duka sun sami lalacewa. Gidajen da suke nesa da gaɓa ba su sami lalacewa sosai ba.

Bayan awanni biyu, ma'aikatan agaji suka iso a cikin motoci. Suka kawo agaji: shinkafa, da ruwan sha, da babbar leda. Kowane iyali ya sami shinkafa da leda. "Ka rufe ɗakinka da wannan leda kafin ku gyara gidan," wani ma'aikacin agaji ya ce wa Rabilu.

Rabilu ya rufe ɗaki ɗaya da leda. Da dare iyalin suka kwana a ƙarƙashin leda. Hamida ta dafa shinkafa a waje.

Da suke cin shinkafar, Hamida ta ce, "Leda mafita ce ta 'yan kwanaki kawai. Leda ba ta da ƙarfi. Idan wata guguwa ta zo, za ta tafi da ita."

"To, ina mafita?" Rabilu ya ce.

"Mafita ita ce mu gina gida nesa da gaɓar kogi," Hamida ta ce. "Kowace shekara akwai guguwa a nan. Ba na so yaranmu su sake kwana a waje."

Rabilu ya yi tunani. Bayan mako ɗaya, ya je wurin mai gari ya nemi fili a bayan gari. Mai garin ya ba shi fili. Da taimakon 'yan uwansa, Rabilu ya fara gina sabon gida nesa da gaɓa. Yana zuwa kogi da safe, amma iyalinsa za su kwana a wuri mai nisa da kogi.

Tambayoyi:
Ina gidan Rabilu yake?
Gidansa yana a gaɓar kogi, kusa da garin Yauri.
Guguwar ta yi awanni nawa?
Ta yi awanni uku.
Me ma'aikatan agaji suka kawo?
Sun kawo shinkafa, da ruwan sha, da babbar leda.
Me ya sa Hamida ta ce leda ba mafita ba ce?
Saboda leda ba ta da ƙarfi, kuma idan wata guguwa ta zo, za ta tafi da ita.
Wace mafita Hamida ta gani?
Ta ce su gina gida nesa da gaɓar kogi.

lessons.title: Taron mazauna unguwa
lessons.summary: At the monthly residents' meeting in Barnawa, Kaduna, the nurse Sa'adiya warns that children's fevers come from the rubbish and dirty water; a man claims it is the government's job, and chairman Ismail goes to represent them at the local government.
lessons.text:
Kowane wata, mazauna Barnawa a Kaduna sukan yi taro a ƙarƙashin wata babbar bishiya. Shugaban taron shi ne Malam Ismail, wani malamin makaranta.

A wannan wata, Malam Ismail ya ce, "Muna da batutuwa uku a yau: shara, da ruwan sha, da tsaro. Bari mu fara da batun farko."

Sai wata mata mai suna Sa'adiya ta tashi. Sa'adiya tana aiki a wani asibiti kusa da Barnawa. "A wannan wata, yara goma daga Barnawa sun zo asibitinmu da zazzaɓi," ta ce. "Zazzaɓin yana da alaƙa da sharar da ke kan hanya da ruwan da ke tsaye a cikin ramuka. Sauro suna haihuwa a cikin ruwan nan. Idan ba mu kwashe sharar ba, cututtuka za su ci gaba da yaɗuwa."

Wani mutum ya ce, "Wane irin cututtuka ne?"

"Zazzaɓi, da ciwon ciki, da wasu cututtuka," Sa'adiya ta ce. "Yaɗuwar cututtukan nan tana da sauri a lokacin damina."

Wani dattijo kuma ya tashi. Ya yi iƙirari cewa sharar ba laifin mazauna ba ne. "Aikin gwamnati ne ta kwashe shara," ya ce. "Ba mu ne za mu yi aikin gwamnati ba."

Sa'adiya ta ce, "Iƙirarinka yana da gaskiya, Baba. Amma yaranmu ne suke samun zazzaɓi, ba yaran gwamnati ba."

Mutane suka yi dariya. Zancen ya ɗauki lokaci mai tsawo. Kowa ya ambaci wani abu: wani ya ambaci ruwan sha, wani ya ambaci ɓarayi. Amma Malam Ismail ya ce, "Bari mu gama zancen shara kafin mu koma wasu batutuwa."

A ƙarshe, mazauna suka yarda da abubuwa biyu. Na farko, kowane mako za su kwashe shara daga hanyoyi tare. Na biyu, Malam Ismail zai yi musu wakilci a ofishin ƙaramar hukuma. Zai je ya faɗa musu cewa Barnawa tana buƙatar motar kwashe shara.

Malam Ismail ya je ya yi wakilci mai kyau. Daga bisani, ƙaramar hukuma ta aiko da mota sau biyu a mako. Daga bisani kuma, Sa'adiya ta faɗa a taron wata mai zuwa cewa yaran da suke zuwa asibiti da zazzaɓi ba su da yawa kamar da.

Tambayoyi:
Batutuwa nawa ne a taron?
Akwai batutuwa uku: shara, da ruwan sha, da tsaro.
Me Sa'adiya ta ce game da zazzaɓi?
Ta ce yara goma daga Barnawa sun zo asibiti da zazzaɓi.
Wane iƙirari dattijon ya yi?
Ya ce aikin gwamnati ne ta kwashe shara.
Wa zai yi wa mazauna wakilci a ƙaramar hukuma?
Malam Ismail ne zai yi musu wakilci.
Me ya faru daga bisani?
Ƙaramar hukuma ta aiko da mota sau biyu a mako, kuma yaran da suke da zazzaɓi ba su da yawa kamar da.

lessons.title: Lambun Malam Alhassan
lessons.summary: After retiring from a ministry in Abuja, Alhassan, whose blood pressure makes climbing to their fourth-floor flat hard, moves with his wife Mairami to a house with a garden in Gombe that they saved for.
lessons.text:
Malam Alhassan ya yi shekara 35 yana aiki a wata ma'aikata a Abuja. A wannan shekara ya yi ritaya. Shi da matarsa Mairami suna zaune a wani gida a hawa na huɗu na wani dogon gini.

Kafin ritayarsa, Malam Alhassan ba ya jin daɗin hawan matakala. Yana da hawan jini, kuma hawan matakala kowace rana yana sa shi ya gaji. Likita ya ce masa, "Kana buƙatar motsi, amma ba irin wannan motsi ba. Ka yi tafiya a ƙasa, a waje, a wuri mai iska."

Shekaru da yawa, Malam Alhassan da Mairami suna adana kuɗi a banki. Suna so su gina gida a Gombe, garinsu. Kowane wata suna adana ɗan abu kaɗan daga albashinsa. Da kuɗin da suka adana, suka gina gida ƙarami mai fili a gaba.

Bayan ritayarsa, suka sauya rayuwarsu. Suka bar Abuja, suka koma Gombe. "Mun sauya gari, mun sauya gida, yanzu kuma za mu sauya yadda muke rayuwa," Mairami ta ce.

A filin da ke gaban gidan, Malam Alhassan ya yi lambu. Ya sa furanni da itatuwa. Kowace safiya yakan tashi da wuri ya ba lambun ruwa. Yakan yi tafiya a cikin lambu yana duba furanninsa. Wannan shi ne motsin da likita ya ce yana buƙata.

Furannin Malam Alhassan suna da ƙanshi mai daɗi. Da safe, ƙanshin furannin yana shiga gidan ta taga. Mairami ta ce, "Ƙanshin nan ya fi duk ƙanshin da na ji a Abuja."

Da yamma, Malam Alhassan da Mairami sukan zauna a cikin lambu suna kallon faɗuwar rana. A Abuja ba sa ganin faɗuwar rana, saboda dogayen gidaje. A Gombe kuma, faɗuwar rana tana da kyau sosai.

Bayan wata uku, Malam Alhassan ya je wurin likita. Likitan ya duba shi ya ce, "Hawan jininka ya yi ƙasa. Me ka sauya?"

Malam Alhassan ya yi dariya. "Na yi ritaya, na bar hawan matakala, kuma yanzu ina da lambu," ya ce.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Malam Alhassan ba ya jin daɗin hawan matakala?
Saboda yana da hawan jini, kuma hawan matakala yana sa shi ya gaji.
Yaya suka sami kuɗin gina gidan Gombe?
Suna adana kuɗi a banki kowane wata.
Me Malam Alhassan yakan yi kowace safiya?
Yakan tashi da wuri ya ba lambun ruwa.
Me Mairami ta ce game da ƙanshin furanni?
Ta ce ƙanshin ya fi duk ƙanshin da ta ji a Abuja.
Me suke kallo da yamma?
Suna kallon faɗuwar rana.

lessons.title: Wasiƙa daga Landan
lessons.summary: In a letter to her sister in Kano, Lubna tells how her London rent went up, how she found a medium-sized flat to share with a friend, and how different the cold and the snow are from home.
lessons.text:
'Yar uwata Ummulkhairi,

Ina fatan kina lafiya, ke da Baba da Mama. Ni ma ina lafiya a nan Landan, amma ana dari sosai. A wannan mako an yi dusar ƙanƙara a karon farko. Dusar ƙanƙara ta rufe hanyoyi da motoci da gidaje. Na fita na taɓa ta da hannuna. Tana da sanyi kamar ƙanƙara! Dari na nan ya sha bamban da sanyin Kano. A Kano, sanyi yana zuwa da iska. A nan kuma, dari yana shiga har cikin jiki, ko da kana cikin gida.

Na rubuta wannan wasiƙa ne saboda wani labari game da gidana. Mai gidan da nake zaune ya ce za a yi ƙaruwar kuɗin gida. Ƙaruwar ta kai rabin abin da nake biya a da. Na tambaye shi dalili. Ya ce kuɗin komai ya ƙaru, kuma yana son riba. Ya ce gidaje a wannan gari suna kawo riba sosai yanzu, kuma kowa yana son riba.

Ba ni da kuɗin da zan biya wannan ƙaruwa. Saboda haka na fara neman wani gida. Wata ƙawata mai suna Nasiba ita ma tana neman gida. Sai muka yanke shawarar mu zauna tare. Mun sami wani matsakaicin gida mai ɗakuna biyu, ba babba ba, ba ƙarami ba. Matsakaicin gida ne, amma yana da kyau, kuma yana da haske.

Kowace ɗaya daga cikinmu za ta biya rabonta na kuɗin gidan. Rabona bai kai rabin abin da nake biya a da ba. Kowane wata zan biya rabona daga asusuna na banki. Nasiba ma za ta biya rabonta daga asusunta.

Gidan yana kusa da wata kasuwa. Kasuwar wuri ne sananne, kuma mutane daga ƙasashe da yawa suna zuwa can. A cikin wannan sanannen wuri akwai wani shago da yake sayar da kayan abincin Afirka. Rayuwa a nan ta sha bamban da ta gida, amma idan na je wannan shago, ina jin kamar ina Kano.

Ki gai da Baba da Mama. Ki faɗa musu cewa ina lafiya, kuma ina da gida mai kyau yanzu.

'Yar uwarki,
Lubna

Tambayoyi:
Me ya faru a Landan a wannan mako?
An yi dusar ƙanƙara a karon farko.
Me mai gidan Lubna ya ce?
Ya ce za a yi ƙaruwar kuɗin gida, saboda yana son riba.
Wane irin gida Lubna da Nasiba suka samu?
Sun sami matsakaicin gida mai ɗakuna biyu.
Ta yaya Lubna za ta biya rabonta?
Za ta biya rabonta daga asusunta na banki.
Ina gidan yake?
Gidan yana kusa da wata kasuwa, wani sanannen wuri.

lessons.title: Gida kusa da coci
lessons.summary: Bitrus and Rifkatu move from Jos to Kaduna and want a house near their church; an agent's many offers confuse Bitrus, so he asks Ishaya, the head of their church, who finds them an honest landlord.
lessons.text:
Bitrus da matarsa Rifkatu sun taso a Jos, amma yanzu Bitrus ya sami aiki a Kaduna. Dole ne su nemi gida a Kaduna.

Rifkatu ta ce, "Ina so gidanmu ya kasance kusa da coci. Ina zuwa ibada kowace safiya. Kuma ranar Lahadi ana fara babbar ibada da ƙarfe takwas da kwata."

Bitrus ya je wurin wani wakili mai nuna wa mutane gidaje. Wakilin ya nuna masa gidaje da yawa: wani babba, wani ƙarami, wani mai tsada sosai, wani mai ɗan tsada. Wani yana kusa da kasuwa, wani yana kusa da makaranta. Bitrus ya rikice. Bai san wanne ne ya fi kyau ba. Kuma wakilin ya ce dole ne ya biya kuɗin gida na shekara biyu, da wasu kuɗi masu yawa na wakili.

Da ya koma gida, ya ce wa Rifkatu, "Na rikice. Gidaje sun yi yawa, kuɗi kuma sun yi yawa."

Rifkatu ta ce, "Ka tambayi Malam Ishaya. Shi ne shugaban cocin da muke zuwa a nan Kaduna."

Ranar Lahadi, Rifkatu ta yi ado da sabuwar riga mai launin kore. Bitrus ma ya yi ado da farar riga. Suka je coci da ƙarfe takwas saura kwata. Bayan ibada, Bitrus ya tambayi Malam Ishaya ko ya san wani gida.

Malam Ishaya ya ce, "Kada ka yarda da wannan wakili. Cutar mutane saboda kuɗi saɓo ne. Wanda yake bauta wa Allah ba ya cutar da mutane. Duk wanda ya karɓi kuɗi ba bisa gaskiya ba, ya yi saɓo."

Sai Malam Ishaya ya ce wani daga cikin mutanen cocin yana da gida kusa da cocin. Gidan yana da ɗakuna uku, kuma mai gidan mutum ne mai gaskiya. Ba ya karɓar kuɗi na shekara biyu. Ana biyansa kowane wata.

Bitrus da Rifkatu suka je suka ga gidan. Gidan yana da kyau, kuma daga ƙofarsa suna iya ganin cocin.

Malam Ishaya ya ce, "Allah ya sa ku zauna lafiya a sabon gidanku. Ku ci gaba da bauta wa Allah."

"Amin," Bitrus da Rifkatu suka ce. "Amin, amin."

Yanzu kowace safiya Rifkatu tana tafiya da ƙafa zuwa ibada. Ba ta buƙatar mota. Kuma ranar Lahadi, suna isa coci tun kafin ƙarfe takwas da kwata.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Rifkatu take so gidansu ya kasance kusa da coci?
Saboda tana zuwa ibada kowace safiya.
Me ya sa Bitrus ya rikice?
Saboda wakilin ya nuna masa gidaje da yawa, kuma kuɗi sun yi yawa.
Wa Bitrus ya tambaya?
Ya tambayi Malam Ishaya, shugaban cocin.
Me Malam Ishaya ya ce game da cutar mutane saboda kuɗi?
Ya ce saɓo ne.
Yaushe ake fara babbar ibada ranar Lahadi?
Ana fara ta da ƙarfe takwas da kwata.

lessons.title: Gidan Safiyanu
lessons.summary: Safiyanu, who works in the Sharada factories, sees in the newspaper that a company sells houses to factory workers; to reach the house he learns to drive with Kulsum, who says he has a talent for it.
lessons.text:
Safiyanu yana aiki a wani kamfanin yin takalma a unguwar masana'antu ta Sharada a Kano. Unguwar tana da masana'antu da yawa: na takalma, na kaya, na abinci. Safiyanu ya yi shekara goma yana biyan kuɗin haya, amma yana so ya mallaki gidansa.

Kowace Lahadi Safiyanu yakan sayi jarida. Yakan karanta shafukan da suke da tallar gidaje. Wata Lahadi, a ɗaya daga cikin shafukan jaridar, ya ga wani labari: wani kamfani yana sayar da sababbin gidaje ga ma'aikatan masana'antu. Ana biyan kuɗin gidan kaɗan kaɗan har shekara goma.

"Wannan zarafi ne!" Safiyanu ya ce wa kansa. "Ba kowace rana ake samun irin wannan zarafi ba."

Ya je ofishin kamfanin. Wata ma'aikaciya ta ce masa, "Wanda ya yi shekara biyar a masana'antu ne kawai ya cancanci wannan gida." Safiyanu ya nuna mata takardunsa. "Kai, ka cancanci gidan," ta ce. "Ka yi shekara goma."

Amma akwai matsala. Sababbin gidajen suna da nisa daga masana'antu. Babu motar haya a hanyar. Safiyanu yana da tsohuwar mota daga ɗan uwansa, amma bai iya tuƙi ba.

Sai ya je makarantar koyon tuƙi. Malamar tuƙinsa wata mace ce mai suna Kulsum. A rana ta farko, Safiyanu bai iya tayar da motar ba. Ya juya makulli, amma motar ba ta tashi ba.

Kulsum ta ce, "Ka sa ƙafarka a nan, sannan ka tayar da ita." Safiyanu ya sake yi, motar kuma ta tashi.

Bayan wata biyu, Safiyanu ya iya tuƙi sosai. Kulsum ta ce, "Kana da basira. Wasu mutane suna yin wata shida kafin su iya tuƙi, amma kai, da basirarka, ka koya a wata biyu."

Bayan wata uku, Safiyanu ya karɓi makullin sabon gidansa. Yanzu kowace safiya yana tayar da motarsa ya tafi masana'antu. Ya ce, "Mallakar gida abu ne mai daɗi. Mallakar gida ta fi biyan kuɗin haya kowace shekara."

Tambayoyi:
Ina Safiyanu yake aiki?
Yana aiki a wani kamfani a unguwar masana'antu ta Sharada.
Ina ya ga labarin gidajen?
Ya gan shi a ɗaya daga cikin shafukan jarida.
Wane ne ya cancanci gidajen?
Wanda ya yi shekara biyar a masana'antu ne ya cancanci gidajen.
Me ya faru a ranar farko ta koyon tuƙi?
Safiyanu bai iya tayar da motar ba.
Me Kulsum ta ce game da Safiyanu?
Ta ce yana da basira.

lessons.title: Sabuwar maƙwabciya
lessons.summary: When Zulfa moves into a house in Bauchi that stood empty for two years, the old neighbour Bintu brings her soup with smoked fish, explains the false rumour of a killing in the house, and asks Zulfa a favour.
lessons.text:
Zulfa da mijinta sun koma wani gida a Bauchi. Gidan ya yi shekara biyu babu kowa a ciki. Kuɗin gidan ba shi da yawa, amma Zulfa ba ta san dalili ba.

Rana ta biyu, wata mace mai yawan shekaru ta buga ƙofa. "Sunana Bintu," ta ce. "Gidana yana nan a gefe, kusa da naku. Na kawo miki miya." Ta ba Zulfa wata babbar tasa. A cikin tasar akwai miyar kuka da banda.

"Na gode, Mama," Zulfa ta ce. "Bandar nan tana da ƙanshi mai daɗi. Ke kika yi ta?"

"Eh, ɗana yana kawo mini kifi daga Kogin Gongola. Nakan sa kifin a kan wuta har ya zama banda. Banda tana sa miya ta yi daɗi."

Zulfa ta ajiye tasar a gefe, ta kawo kujera. Bintu ta zauna kusa da ƙofa. Sai Zulfa ta tambayi Bintu, "Mama, me ya sa wannan gida ya yi shekara biyu babu kowa?"

Bintu ta yi shiru kaɗan. "Zan faɗa miki gaskiya," ta ce. "Mutane sun ce an yi kisa a gidan nan. Amma ba gaskiya ba ne. Ba a taɓa yin kisa a nan ba."

"To, me ya faru?" Zulfa ta ce.

"Mai gidan, Malam Mu'azu, tsoho ne. Ya mutu a asibiti. Aka kawo gawarsa nan gida, aka yi masa salla, sannan aka kai gawar makabarta. Wasu yara suka ga gawar, suka faɗa wa mutane cewa an yi kisa. Labarin ƙarya ya fara yaɗuwa. 'Ya'yansa suna zaune a Legas, sai yanzu suka ba da gidan."

Zulfa ta ji sauƙi. "Na gode da kika faɗa mini," ta ce.

"Ina da roƙo guda," Bintu ta ce. "Jikata tana zuwa makaranta kusa da nan. Idan ina tafiya, roƙona shi ne ki bar ta ta zauna a gidanki bayan makaranta, har mahaifiyarta ta zo."

"Ba matsala, Mama," Zulfa ta ce. "Na karɓi roƙonki. Kamar yadda kika kawo mini miya, ni ma zan kula da yarinyar."

Da safe, Zulfa ta wanke tasar Bintu. Ta sa shinkafa da ɗan nama a cikin tasar, ta kai wa Bintu. "Ga tasarki, Mama. Na kawo miki shinkafa," ta ce.

Bintu ta yi dariya. "Ashe kina bin al'ada! Ba a mayar da tasa babu komai a ciki."

Tambayoyi:
Ina gidan Bintu yake?
Gidanta yana nan a gefe, kusa da gidan Zulfa.
Me Bintu ta kawo wa Zulfa?
Ta kawo mata miyar kuka da banda a cikin tasa.
Me mutane suka ce game da gidan?
Sun ce an yi kisa a gidan, amma ba gaskiya ba ne.
Me ya faru da Malam Mu'azu?
Ya mutu a asibiti, aka kawo gawarsa gida, sannan aka kai ta makabarta.
Wane roƙo Bintu ta yi?
Ta ce Zulfa ta bar jikarta ta zauna a gidanta bayan makaranta.
Me Zulfa ta sa a cikin tasar?
Ta sa shinkafa da ɗan nama.
